chunks: In which case he will be punished by God with the severest punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the severest punishment mentioned in Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific transgressor of 'giving' or 'taking' (as in Surah Al-Infitar 82:6), highlighting the gravity of violating divine trusts. The 'greatest punishment' (al-ʿadhāb al--akbar) is interpreted not merely as intensity but as the culmination of divine justice, often associated with the severity of the sin itself or the loss of divine proximity. This serves as a warning to believers about the eternal consequences of specific moral and ritual failures.
